     WHEN failure_percentage >= 1 OR warn_failed_records > 0 THEN '2 - Elevated'

config.source:
WITH q AS (
  SELECT 'customers' AS entity, 'mavenmarket.silver.quarantine_customers' AS quarantine_table, CAST(_ingestion_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS detected_at, CAST(_ingestion_timestamp AS DATE) AS record_date, quarantine_reasons FROM mavenmarket.silver.quarantine_customers
  UNION ALL SELECT 'stores', 'mavenmarket.silver.quarantine_stores', ingested_timestamp, CAST(ingested_timestamp AS DATE), quarantine_reasons FROM mavenmarket.silver.quarantine_stores
  UNION ALL SELECT 'transactions', 'mavenmarket.silver.quarantine_transactions', ingested_timestamp, CAST(transaction_date AS DATE), quarantine_reasons FROM mavenmarket.silver.quarantine_transactions
  UNION ALL SELECT 'returns', 'mavenmarket.silver.quarantine_returns', ingested_timestamp, CAST(return_date AS DATE), quarantine_reasons FROM mavenmarket.silver.quarantine_returns
  UNION ALL SELECT 'inventory', 'mavenmarket.silver.quarantine_inventory', _ingestion_timestamp, CAST(restock_date AS DATE), quarantine_reasons FROM mavenmarket.silver.quarantine_inventory
  UNION ALL SELECT 'products', 'mavenmarket.silver.quarantine_products', _ingestion_timestamp, CAST(_ingestion_timestamp AS DATE), quarantine_reasons FROM mavenmarket.silver.quarantine_products
  UNION ALL SELECT 'promotions', 'mavenmarket.silver.quarantine_promotions', ingested_timestamp, CAST(ingested_timestamp AS DATE), quarantine_reasons FROM mavenmarket.silver.quarantine_promotions
  UNION ALL SELECT 'regions', 'mavenmarket.silver.quarantine_regions', ingested_timestamp, CAST(ingested_timestamp AS DATE), quarantine_reasons FROM mavenmarket.silver.quarantine_regions
  UNION ALL SELECT 'calendar', 'mavenmarket.silver.quarantine_calendar', _ingestion_timestamp, CAST(_ingestion_timestamp AS DATE), quarantine_reasons FROM mavenmarket.silver.quarantine_calendar
)
SELECT entity, quarantine_table, detected_at, record_date, TRIM(chk) AS failed_check
FROM q LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(COALESCE(quarantine_reasons, 'Unknown: unspecified'), ';')) t AS chk
WHERE TRIM(chk) <> ''
config.comment: Failed hard checks exploded from all silver quarantine tables
